snippet.title: Flash Party Launch Trailer | 17 Feb 2022
snippet.description: Dear party players, thank you for supporting Flash Party during our EA on TapTap. On 17 Feb, we will officially start the global soft launch. This time we have prepared 7-day sign-in rewards, event Double Novas, new heroes and a new season for the update. Wish you all have fun!
